test_change.scope: Test-only replacement of the live-ledger test input with the exact immutable ledger-130 archive fixture; production source is unchanged.

test_safety_checks_reviewed: Pins the exact manifest SHA and validates its schema, archive name, compressed size and SHA, and uncompressed size and production ledger SHA.
Uses the fixed ledger-130-01 directory and rejects any manifest archive_path other than ledger-v1.jsonl.gz before joining the path.
Bounds zlib decompression to expected decoded bytes plus one, rejects unconsumed input, requires gzip EOF, and rejects trailing data or concatenated members.
Requires exact decoded byte length and SHA, 130 LF-terminated rows, equality of all 130 line hashes to the pinned manifest, and successful production validate_ledger_history validation.
Does not read reports/releases/v0.9.2/ledger-v1.jsonl or a latest ledger index, and does not extract archive members.
immutable_archive_review.decoded_content_review_basis: The test source and hash-bound output report these checks passing; reviewer inspected the bounded decode assertions and did not rerun the test or independently decompress the ledger.

non_blocking_note.observation: The test calls Path.read_bytes for the manifest and compressed archive before asserting their exact lengths. The current pinned files are regular files of 10,036 and 13,299,105 bytes, and decompression output is capped at expected bytes plus one. A pre-read stat or bounded-read check would also cap allocation if a fixture path were unexpectedly replaced with a much larger file.

scope.statement: Read-only review of the append-only test fixture update, its hash-bound receipt and output, immutable archive inputs, and unchanged production-source hashes. This does not modify or supersede independent-source-review-01 and grants no request, admission, execution, qualification, or publication authority.
